task: Improve setup WNS of the native RTL without changing cycle-level behavior.
constraints: Preserve top name, native ports and widths, signedness, reset polarity, enables and exact output latency.
Keep a single direct positive-edge clock; do not introduce async reset, latches, memories or generated clocks.
Do not add assume/assert, initial assignments or unknown/high-impedance values to evade verification.
The original frozen RTL is the functional reference for every candidate, not the last candidate.
Startup assumptions are fixed and identical for the original and all candidates; never extend them.
Top parameter overrides and shared dependency modules are frozen. Do not redefine those helper modules in candidate_rtl.
WNS is measured at fixed clock/IO/library settings. Do not claim measured improvements before EDA.
functional_contract: Preserve outputs ready, dispense, return_sig and bill for every sampled input sequence after the fixed startup reset, including ten=twenty=1 (ten has source-defined priority) and arbitrary later clear assertions. Preserve original module parameter declarations and defaults. No added init/assume, unreachable-state input assumptions, or latency changes. Proof applies to default ON=1 and OFF=0 only.
objective: Strictly improve worst setup slack without regressing TNS, within fixed area budget. Original baseline remains available. No measured gain claim before EDA.
